qa_enrichments.topic: ERP & Supply Chain Planning Platforms (SAP, Power BI Integration)
qa_enrichments.question: How would you like to frame your experience with ERP and Supply Chain / Demand Planning platforms (such as SAP, APO, Kinaxis, Oracle) for this Castrol / bp role?
qa_enrichments.answer: Primarily focused on building custom BI dashboards (Power BI/Tableau/Excel) and Power Automate workflows integrated with ERP (SAP) and data lake backends, with strong capability in translating operational and supply planning datasets into executive cluster performance packs.
qa_enrichments.position_context: bp / Castrol - CF & Planning Performance Analyst
